abstract_sentences.text: Quality diversity (QD) optimization searches for a collection of solutions that optimize an objective while attaining diverse outputs of a user-specified, vector-valued measure function.

evidence.anchor: Quality diversity (QD) optimization searches for a collection of solutions

abstract_sentences.text: Contemporary QD algorithms are typically limited to low-dimensional measures because high-dimensional measures are prone to distortion, where many solutions found by the QD algorithm map to similar measures.

evidence.anchor: high-dimensional measures are prone to distortion

abstract_sentences.text: For example, the state-of-the-art CMA-MAE algorithm guides measure space exploration with a histogram in measure space that records so-called discount values.

evidence.anchor: CMA-MAE algorithm guides measure space exploration with a histogram

abstract_sentences.text: However, CMA-MAE stagnates in domains with high-dimensional measure spaces because solutions with similar measures fall into the same histogram cell and hence receive the same discount value.

evidence.anchor: CMA-MAE stagnates in domains with high-dimensional measure spaces

abstract_sentences.text: To address these limitations, we propose Discount Model Search (DMS), which guides exploration with a model that provides a smooth, continuous representation of discount values.

evidence.anchor: we propose Discount Model Search (DMS)

abstract_sentences.text: In high-dimensional measure spaces, this model enables DMS to distinguish between solutions with similar measures and thus continue exploration.

evidence.anchor: distinguish between solutions with similar measures and thus continue exploration

abstract_sentences.text: We show that DMS facilitates new capabilities for QD algorithms by introducing two new domains where the measure space is the high-dimensional space of images, which enables users to specify their desired measures by providing a dataset of images rather than hand-designing the measure function.

evidence.anchor: two new domains where the measure space is the high-dimensional space of images

abstract_sentences.text: Results in these domains and on high-dimensional benchmarks show that DMS outperforms CMA-MAE and other existing black-box QD algorithms.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 高维 measure distortion 让 CMA-MAE 的离散 histogram 把相近解压到同一 discount；DMS 用 smooth neural discount model 加 empty-cell 的 f_min 约束恢复 archive-improvement 方向，并将 QD 推到 dataset-defined image measures（pp.2,5–7,9）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 problem formulation、CMA-MAE failure、DMS 的 Eq. (1)/Algorithm 1、QDDM 两个 domain、Table 1 主结果、Welch/Games-Howell 选择、Table 2 计算代价和主要 limitations（pp.3–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承担完整曲线/误差、pairwise 表、hyperparameters、三组消融、domain formulas、nearest-neighbor 实现、硬件和 DQD 边界；迁移保持正文可读性，但使统计细节与完全复现依赖附录（pp.19–39）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Fig.1 的 failure/repair 并排机制图、Algorithm 1 的训练-搜索同循环、Table 1 的全域决策指标，以及 Fig.8/11 对 discount model 空间输出的机制可视化形成最有效组合（pp.2,6,8,26,34）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 广泛的 “outperforms” 叙述超出实证边界：Arm coverage 由 DDS 更高，TA MNIST 对 CMA-MAE 无显著 QD Score 差异，LSI 与 MAP-Elites 无显著差异，QDDM 还缺 DDS；seed、held-out dataset、用户 effort 和复杂 discount architecture 也未验证（pp.8–10,29–31）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 当论文把 archive failure 归因于表示分辨率时，应提供离散碰撞图、连续替代机制、未探索区约束和逐 domain 决策指标，并把平滑表示拆成可消融的训练目标与边界条件（pp.2,6,9,31–35）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有 archive state、可计算 improvement 和可视化 measure geometry 的 black-box QD；dataset 代表性、nearest-neighbor 瓶颈、模型误差主导 objective ranking 或 differentiable-gradient 要求出现时，本文不能直接外推（pp.7,9,30–31,39）。
